meta.note: 2026-09-14 run. HOUSEKEEPING: main had been stuck at the 2026-09-06 ("Day 10") state for 8 days -- at least 11 unmerged claude/bold-clarke-* branches piled up in that window (one, PR #2 / claude/bold-clarke-4loiws, still open and now marked conflicting), and the most recent daily session (2026-09-13, sent by email but never pushed/PR'd) started from scratch with no memory of the tracker at all, re-establishing a false 'baseline' with zero applications on record. This run reconciles the true state by diffing live board fetches directly against the 2026-09-06 tracker.json (the last state actually merged into main) and pulling everything reported by email in between (2026-09-07 through 2026-09-13, all in Gmail) plus the user's own 2026-09-08 application-status email, which had not yet been persisted anywhere. Closed 2 reposted Anduril Waltham reqs (new IDs opened same day) and added 4 new tracked-board postings, 5 new user-reported applications, and 3 new watchlist companies (Merlin Labs, Grid Aero, Enigma Aerospace). Added 'merlinlabs' and 'crgo' (Enigma Aerospace) to config.json lever_slugs so both are tracked automatically going forward -- previously only Anduril, Vannevar Labs, and Shield AI were watched, which is why several days of web-sweep-only finds (documented in email but not in git) never got picked up by the automated pipeline. Flagging the branch pileup and PR #2 to the user directly rather than unilaterally deleting anything.

skill_gaps_ranked: C/C++ for embedded/real-time flight software -- still #1 by a wide margin; every embedded/RTOS flight-software posting (Anduril, Grid Aero, Merlin Labs) calls out systems programming in C/C++ specifically, on top of MATLAB/Simulink.

State estimation / Kalman filtering (EKF/UKF) & sensor fusion -- Shield AI's dedicated State Estimation ladder and now its new San Diego 'Autonomous Systems Integration' req, plus Anduril's Navigation & Estimation track, all want this explicitly.

DO-178C / DO-254 avionics certification -- NEW gap surfaced 9/13. Distinct from the weapons-system-safety standard already on the resume (MIL-STD-882E/FHA/FTA); Merlin Labs in particular is certification-focused since it retrofits certified aircraft.

VTOL/eVTOL hover-to-wing-borne transition-phase control -- NEW gap surfaced 9/13. The quadrotor sim work under Dr. Atkins is hover-only; Shield AI's X-BAT and Anduril's Rotorcraft/VTOL reqs specifically need transition-phase modeling.
PX4/ArduPilot autopilot stack -- Auterion, Delta Black Aerospace, Allen Control Systems, Skyways all want hands-on autopilot-stack experience.

Trajectory optimization tooling (GPOPS-II, CasADi, Dymos, IPOPT) -- recurring Anduril preferred qualification; Simulink-to-C/C++ auto code generation remains the fastest of these gaps to close given the existing Simulink skill.
